<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def greens(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("greens before:", greens(current_frame))
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':3,'col':15}], intent='explore')
print("greens after:", greens(current_frame))
print("board_changed:", res.get('board_changed'), "gameplay_changed:", res.get('gameplay_changed'), "no_impact:", res.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
